_comment: Frame-time budgets per machine class (prefix of the harness machine id). Machines not listed get baseline regression checks only. See docs/PERFORMANCE.md. These budgets are set by the user: agents never change them.

nvidia-geforce-rtx-5090._comment: Dev machine. Native 2560x1440, no upscaling, no frame generation, High quality preset (LOD pixel error 1.0), MSAA 4x. 600 fps average, 480 fps 1% low (lowered by the user on 2026-11-04 from 1000 / 800; every frame-time limit scaled by the same factor). The user lowers it further as the project matures.
